title: 第553章 我绝不能允许庆典之时血刀门缺席第552章 这其中必有蹊跷
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
听完执事的禀报，六极宫主眉头紧锁，在大殿中缓缓踱了几步。
虽说他想不明白这其中究竟有什么蹊跷，但他知道六极宫的千年庆典，是整个西漠百年一遇的盛事。
届时西漠百余宗门齐聚一堂，无数双眼睛都在盯着六极宫。
他作为宫主，不能因为血刀门的变故就打乱庆典的节奏。
更何况天阶丹药已经有着落了，庆典的底气已经有了，他更不能在这个节骨眼上自乱阵脚。
而且若血刀门真的遭遇了不测，那他现在派人去东荒，一来未必来得及，二来也师出无名。
毕竟是血刀门自己跑去东荒的，六极宫贸然介入，反倒显得理亏。
若他们没有遭遇不测，只是被什么事情耽搁了，那他更不需要着急。
血刀门的人知道庆典的重要性，黎川身为门主，不可能不清楚缺席庆典的后果。
只要他们还活着，就一定会想办法赶回来。
所以最稳妥的做法，就是等。
等到庆典临近，一切自然会见分晓。
若他们回来了，他正好可以当面问清东荒到底发生了什么。
若他们回不来……那说明事情的性质就完全不同了。
六极宫主沉默了片刻，缓缓开口道：
“此事确实蹊跷，但眼下不宜轻举妄动。”
“距离庆典还有十几日，先等等看，血刀门的人知道此次庆典的重要性，若他们还活着，必然会在庆典之前赶回来。到那时，我自会当面问个清楚。”
执事点了点头，正要领命退下，却又忽然停住脚步，犹豫了一下，小心翼翼地开口问道：
“那宫主……若十日之后，黎门主他们仍然没有消息呢？若他们真的遇害了……我们该如何应对？”
六极宫主闻言，脚步一顿。

他缓缓走到殿门前，望着夜色中静谧的六极宫山门，沉默了很久。
“血刀门乃我西漠宗门，又是距离东荒最近的顶尖宗门之一。”
“虽然此番是他们主动前往东荒，但他们终究是我西漠修士。”
“唇亡齿寒之下，若东荒有人敢对我西漠的宗门出手，而我六极宫坐视不理，那日后西漠还有谁会信服于我？”
说着，他转过身来，目光如炬地看着那执事：
“若十日后仍无消息，那就召集各峰长老，一起去东荒问个清楚。”
“我绝不能允许庆典之时血刀门缺席！”
……
……
“九转化生丹，你们验一下吧。”
三日后，烟霞峰。
阁楼前。
柳倾颜将一个木匣递给面前的特使。
特使双手接过玉盒，小心翼翼地打开一条缝隙。
刹那间，一股浓郁的药香瞬间扑面而来，光是闻上一口便觉神清气爽、灵气运转都顺畅了几分。
他连忙合上盒盖，脸上满是激动与敬畏之色，再次深深一揖：
“辛苦柳仙子了！”
说着，从怀中取出一枚储物戒指，双手奉上：
“柳仙子，这是西漠六极宫承诺的酬劳，外加六极宫主特意备下的一份薄礼，聊表心意。”
content_en:
After listening to the deacon's report, Palace Master Liuji frowned and slowly walked a few steps in the hall.
Although he couldn't figure out what was strange about it, he knew that the Millennium Celebration of Liuji Palace was a once-in-a-century event in the entire Western Desert.
At that time, more than a hundred sects in the Western Desert would gather together, and countless pairs of eyes would be staring at the Liuji Palace.
As the palace master, he cannot disrupt the rhythm of the celebration just because of the incident at the Blood Knife Sect.
What's more, the heaven-level elixir has already been obtained, and the confidence for the celebration is already there, so he can't mess up his position at this juncture.
And if the Blood Knife Sect really encounters something unexpected, then if he sends people to the Eastern Wasteland now, he may not be able to make it in time, and secondly, he will also be able to defeat Wu Ming.
After all, it was the Blood Knife Sect who ran to Donghuang on their own, so Liuji Palace rashly intervened, which seemed unreasonable.
If they didn't encounter any accidents and were just delayed by something, then there was no need for him to be anxious.
The people of the Blood Knife Sect know the importance of the celebration. As the sect leader, Li Chuan cannot be unaware of the consequences of missing the celebration.
As long as they are still alive, they will definitely find a way to come back.
So the safest thing to do is to wait.
When the celebration approaches, everything will naturally come to light.
If they come back, he can ask Qing Donghuang face to face what happened.
If they can't come back... then the nature of the matter will be completely different.
The Master of Liuji Palace was silent for a moment, then slowly said:
"This matter is indeed strange, but it is not appropriate to act rashly at the moment."
"There are still more than ten days before the celebration. Let's wait and see. The people in the Blood Knife Sect know the importance of this celebration. If they are still alive, they will definitely come back before the celebration. By then, I will ask questions in person."
The deacon nodded and was about to take the order to retreat, but suddenly stopped, hesitated, and asked cautiously:
"Then Palace Master... what if there is still no news from Master Li and the others after ten days? If they are really killed... how should we respond?"
The Master of Liuji Palace paused when he heard this.
He walked slowly to the palace gate, looked at the quiet mountain gate of Liuji Palace in the night, and was silent for a long time.
"The Blood Knife Sect is our West Desert Sect, and it is one of the top sects closest to the Eastern Wasteland."
"Although they took the initiative to go to the Eastern Wasteland this time, they are our Western Desert monks after all."
"Under the cold weather, if someone in the Eastern Wasteland dares to take action against my sect in the West Desert, and my Liuji Palace sits back and ignores it, then who else in the West Desert will believe in me in the future?"
As he spoke, he turned around and looked at the deacon with burning eyes:
"If there is still no news after ten days, then summon the elders from all peaks and go to Donghuang to find out."
"I will never allow the Blood Knife Sect to be absent during the celebration!"
…
…
"Nine Transformations Life Pill, please test it."
Three days later, Yanxia Peak.
Front loft.
Liu Qingyan handed a wooden box to the special envoy in front of her.
The special envoy took the jade box with both hands and carefully opened a gap.
In an instant, a strong scent of medicine hit my face. Just one sip made me feel refreshed and my spiritual energy flowed a little smoother.
He quickly closed the lid of the box, his face full of excitement and awe, and he bowed deeply again:
"Thank you Fairy Liu for your hard work!"
As he spoke, he took out a storage ring from his arms and offered it with both hands:
"Fairy Liu, this is the reward promised by Liuji Palace in the West Desert, plus a small gift specially prepared by the master of Liuji Palace to show your appreciation."
